sources.finding: Google documents immutable sub, mutable/nonunique email, email_verified and configurable auth_time/amr claim requests. Published configuration is not an actual enabled-client freshness test. No automatic linking or Tunner assurance follows.

Documents query/fragment/form_post response modes, exact redirect URI matching, code flow, state and optional auth_time claims request. Listed prompt values are none/consent/select_account; prompt=login and max_age are not established as supported from this reference. Qualify any fresh-challenge mechanism, never infer it from account selection.

sections: Use claims to reliably identify a user
sources.finding: sub is immutable and pairwise to an application; tenant/client context must remain in the namespace. oid is a different tenant object identity, not a silent replacement for the chosen sub key. email/preferred_username are mutable and email is not guaranteed correct; they cannot create verified contact/auto-link authority.

Tenant-scoped discovery/endpoints, state/nonce, exact client validation, form_post and prompt=login are documented. Neither a new ID token nor a claimed MFA label establishes Tunner required assurance/currentness without the selected versioned adapter policy.

sections: v1.0 and v2.0 optional claims set
AMR values for Microsoft Entra authentication methods
sources.finding: auth_time and method claims are configurable/profile-dependent. Claim applicability and underlying method semantics must be verified for supported organization/personal account profiles; no universal assurance ordering is selected.

sections: What is an OpenID Connect confidential interactive client
sources.finding: Official ASP.NET guidance recommends confidential code flow with PKCE and framework OIDC client integration. The OIDC package is not currently pinned in this repository. This is a reuse candidate requiring normal dependency/support review, not permission to install/upgrade or replace Tunner session authority.

Stable OIDC identity is issuer plus subject. Protocol freshness requests require validating returned authentication-time evidence; token issuance and authentication time differ. Standard support does not prove each vendor/client implements an optional behavior.

external_provider_activity: None. Documentation browsing did not fetch OIDC discovery/JWKS, redeem a code, authenticate an account or access provider APIs.
